APIToken.description: APIToken is one bearer token entry.

githubOIDC.description:
GitHubOIDC authenticates callers via GitHub Actions OIDC tokens.
No secret is required — the gateway verifies the JWT signature against
GitHub's public JWKS and matches the claims in the allow block.

gitlabOIDC.description: GitLabOIDC authenticates callers via GitLab CI OIDC tokens.

name.description: Name is a human-readable identifier used in logs and audit output.

oidc.description:
OIDC authenticates callers via any OIDC-compliant identity provider.
Issuer is required; the gateway discovers the JWKS URI via
{issuer}/.well-known/openid-configuration.

secretRef.description:
SecretRef reads the token value from a Kubernetes Secret at startup.
If the Secret does not exist, the gateway creates it with a generated
uuidv4 token. If rotateAfter is set, the gateway rotates the token
using the same annotation-based rotation as pkg/runners.

token.description:
Token is an ${ENV_VAR} reference expanded at startup.
Set the variable via extraEnv in the gateway and console Helm values.
Literal values are not accepted.

vaultOIDC.description:
VaultOIDC authenticates callers via HashiCorp Vault OIDC tokens.
The caller authenticates to Vault first (via any Vault auth method), then
presents a Vault-issued OIDC token to the gateway. No stored secret needed.
The gateway discovers the JWKS via {url}/v1/identity/oidc/.well-known/openid-configuration.

GatewayAuthInclude.description: GatewayAuthInclude is the file gateway.api.auth.include names: tokens the inline ones override by name.

GitHubOIDC.description: GitHubOIDC configures authentication via GitHub Actions OIDC tokens.

allow.description: Allow — the claims a token must carry. Each one set must match exactly.

GitHubOIDCClaims.description: GitHubOIDCClaims declares which GitHub-issued claims must match.

environment.description: Environment — the environment claim: the job's deployment environment.

repository.description: Repository — the repository claim, owner/name, e.g. "intentd/inrun".

workflow.description: Workflow — the workflow claim: the workflow's name.

GitLabOIDC.description: GitLabOIDC configures authentication via GitLab CI OIDC tokens.

allow.description: Allow — the claims a token must carry. Each one set must match exactly.

GitLabOIDCClaims.description: GitLabOIDCClaims declares which GitLab-issued claims must match.

environment.description: Environment — the environment claim: the job's environment.

namespacePath.description: NamespacePath — the namespace_path claim: the group or user, e.g. "myorg".

refProtected.description: RefProtected — the ref_protected claim: "true" for a protected branch or tag.

KubernetesSecretRef.description: KubernetesSecretRef locates a Kubernetes Secret that holds a bearer token.

key.description: Key is the data key within the Secret whose value is the token.

name.description: Name is the Kubernetes Secret name.

namespace.description:
Namespace is the Secret's namespace. Required on an external: call's
auth (in a Blueprint or an e2e step); for gateway API tokens and the
remote reconciler's auth it defaults to Inrun's own namespace.

rotateAfter.description:
RotateAfter is an optional duration (e.g. "90d", "720h").
When set, the gateway checks the inrun.dev/generated-at annotation on
the Secret; if the age exceeds this duration, it deletes and recreates
the Secret with a new uuidv4 token.

OIDCToken.description: OIDCToken configures authentication via any OIDC-compliant identity provider.

allow.description:
Allow is a free-form map of claim name → required value.
All declared entries must match — unset keys are not checked.

audience.description:
Audience is the expected `aud` claim value.
When empty, the audience check is skipped.

issuer.description: Issuer is the OIDC provider's issuer URL. Required.

VaultOIDC.description: VaultOIDC configures authentication via HashiCorp Vault OIDC tokens.

allow.description:
Allow declares which Vault identity claims must match.
All declared (non-Empty() fields must match — unset fields are not checked.

audience.description:
Audience is the expected aud claim value in the Vault-issued token.
When empty, the audience check is skipped.

namespace.description:
Namespace is the Vault namespace to scope the issuer to (Vault Enterprise only).
When set, the effective issuer is {url}/v1/{namespace}.

url.description: URL is the Vault server URL (e.g. https://vault.myorg.io). Required.

VaultOIDCClaims.description: VaultOIDCClaims declares which Vault-issued claims must match.

allow.description:
Allow is a free-form map of additional claim name → required value.
Use for any claims configured via Vault's OIDC provider template.

entityID.description: EntityID is the Vault entity ID (stable UUID for the entity).

entityName.description: EntityName is the Vault entity name (identity/entity name).

namespace.description: Namespace is the Vault namespace the entity belongs to (Enterprise only).
